title: Fix "W605 invalid escape sequence" flake8 warnings
commit_message: Fix "W605 invalid escape sequence" flake8 warnings

@@ -46,7 +46,7 @@ def process_sru_bug(lp, bugnum, task_callback, source_callback, context=None):
